text: Everything built so far has been infrastructure nobody at Pinehurst looks at. Now we wire Power BI to the two finished Gold models -- the layer Store Operations opens every morning instead of a 2-day-late report.

Three decisions protect that: Import mode, since Gold refreshes on a 30-minute schedule, not live; connecting through ANALYST_ROLE, which can't see RAW or CURATED; and never relating the two Gold models to each other directly.
Every measure is a straight aggregation of a column dbt already computed. Days of supply and the at-risk flag are never redecided in DAX.
One number gets checked by hand against Snowflake before a single visual exists. If it doesn't match row for row, the model is wrong, not the data.
The semantic layer is live. Next: the meeting where Store Operations sees it for the first time.
